steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: What the...?! THIS is Greta's plan for the shoot?!

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: The Originium storm's right in our faces! What are we, some sort of suicide squad?

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: No... no way... This has to be the killer's doing, right? Didn't you hear the explosion earlier?

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: Someone blew up the plate's cockpit... There's no way we can slow the plate down or change directions now...

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: Right now we're only barely in contact with the storm, but once we hit its core...

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: They're not gonna find even a single brick from this plate... *sob*...

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: Alright, enough!

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: So who on Terra was it? Their revenge wasn't enough for them, so now they're gonna take out the rest of us too?!

steps.name: Voice over the Wireless
steps.text: The... murderer is Moira of the prop team...

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: What? Who's talking?

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: I said! The killer responsible for the three murders is Moira!

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: Moira...? You're kidding me... That unremarkable Zalak?

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Miss Stone caught her red-handed!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: If Lucian weren't there, she would've become the next victim!

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: ...So where's the little rat now? I'll go find her myself!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: And what's the point of confronting a psycho killer when you can't even save yourself?!

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: She owes us an explanation! What if she gets innocents killed?!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: You think I haven't thought of that?!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: I already switched the wireless comms to broadcast mode to ensure I survive this. I'm sure everyone outside the plate has heard the truth by now.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: The killer's trapped like a rat.

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: I have to live, I have to... Once I get back to central Wrankwood, all the bombshells I've collected these past few days will be enough to buy me a villa in Siesta—

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: Shit! The plate's tilting towards the Originium storm again!

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: Right, the landboats! We can use them to escape!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: ...They're gone.

steps.name: Angry Staff
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: I went over to the emergency escape cabin earlier, and they were already wrecked by the storm... every last one of them...

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: There's no way out for us now...

steps.name: Scared Staff
steps.text: ...If I'm going to die anyway, I might as well take the chance and jump off the plate... I...

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Cut that shit out!

steps.name: Camera Assistant
steps.text: Just move! Anywhere's safer than the film set! Let's go hide underground in the engine layer!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: There truly are so many things to learn from the set design of a horror film... Thank you, Tippi.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: No problem!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I have to get back and start making the visualizations for most of the visual effects first, then we'll finalize the details after Director Quay is done with the script.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Like I promised, I'm gonna design you a finale that'll leave Lady Dupont in the cinema history!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Right, I'm looking forward to it.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: (Wait, how long have we talking about this? Did Molly ever find a way to escape—)

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Ahh—!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Wh-What now?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: That's not good.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Wait, there's a voice from the comms...

steps.name: Voice over the Wireless
steps.text: Catastrophe... *bzzt*... control cabin... destroyed...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Why's the signal so bad? It sounded like Abner's assistant. What kinda trouble is he getting into now—

steps.name: Voice over the Wireless
steps.text: The control cabin... has been destroyed...

steps.name: Voice over the Wireless
steps.text: The plate... is rushing towards the Catastrophe...

steps.name: Voice over the Wireless
steps.text: ...killer... is Moira...
Tippi grips the wireless walkie-talkie and turns the volume knob as high as she can, but it stays silent.
She must have misheard, she thinks.
But if so, why is Miss Rutherford looking at her with such a sullen expression?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: No... There's no way...

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Tippi... I can't imagine anyone would joke about that in these circumstances.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But... When would she have even had the opportunity?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: The nights when Shelly, Michael, and Marion died, she was watching movies with me the whole time, there wasn't—
Was there really no opportunity?
Tippi doubts her own mind.
Was Molly really right next to her the whole time during their movie nights?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: We always watched multiple movies back to back, so sometimes she'd leave when I was switching out the tape...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Sometimes she'd say Miss Stone was looking for her, sometimes it was to pick up something she forgot on the film set...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I'm sure you know how she's like, ma'am. She's still new to being the prop master and under, like, a ton of pressure, but she's super committed to her work...

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Darling...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: No, no, that only explains how she could've done it! It doesn't prove that she did...

spans.text: No, no, that only explains how she
done it! It doesn't prove that she did...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: A motive! Why would she kill all those people she had nothing to do with? Why don't I know anything?

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Darling, maybe you didn't know your friend as well as you thought you did.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Let's just focus on the movie... so stop looking away from the screen!

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Sorry, there's just been so much going on with the film crew lately, I'm... I'm a little nervous...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm here for you, girl!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: No matter who I am, one thing's for sure: I'm your best friend on this crew.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Or maybe... maybe she never even thought of me as a friend...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Maybe she was just... using me...
The Liberi girl's head sinks.
She speaks no more.
Melanie hugs the little Liberi in front of her.
The girl who was consoling her just a few hours ago is now crying on her shoulder.
Melanie pats her back. She asks no questions, nor does she say anything about the price of growing up. She only hugs her.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: Let's just leave this place first, Tippi.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: The convoluted structure here will only put us in danger if the plate gets too close to the Catastrophe core.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: We would be safer underground, though that too may be futile if the plate doesn't change direction...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Underground...
Over Melanie's shoulders, Tippi spots some of the material they salvaged from the horror film earlier.
'Underground'—The word circles around her brain.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Wait, I got it!

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: What? You've recovered your pep already?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: No, I figured out how to change the plate's trajectory!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: There was once a crew that snuck into another Wrankwood plate to film secretly—to save on rental costs—and they ended up with a super cool scary movie...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I re-watched it recently.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But that plate and the one we're standing on both came from the same batch made by Wrankwood...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: So basically, the specs should be pretty much the same.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: If my hunch is right... there should be another control cabin at the bottom of the engine layer.

steps.name: Melanie
steps.text: ...What are our odds of making it there?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: To be honest... no idea.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: But never tell me the odds. I gotta try.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: There's no point mulling over something I can't answer on my own. Only when we're out of this crisis...

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Will I be able to get the truth from her.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: (Gentle singing♪)

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: (Cheerful whistling♪)

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: So this is where you were, Lucian.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: That was my sister's favorite song. On breaks between shooting she'd often look to the sky and hum the tune.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I thought you'd already woken up.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Thanks to you. You showed me the truth I was blind to... and how cruel they truly were.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Then what are you doing now?
A rumbling comes from beneath their feet. The Wrankwood plate rushes towards the Catastrophe as the crew panics. No one would think to enter the prop room now, when they should be escaping.
But it is at this very moment that the prop master gets to work.
She goes around the room, fiddling with one mannequin after another, dressing them in clothes, correcting their postures... Her earnest focus is fully on them.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I only just remembered how I recognized Laura.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: If you will allow me a guess... you met someone.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Yes, a very gentle Feline.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: The weather was terrible that day. I was sitting on a bench for a long time, and there was water on my face—probably rain, but maybe tears...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: The accident was caused by the negligence of the person in charge, but in the end I was the one who had to pay compensation and was kicked off the crew.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I didn't know anyone in Wrankwood, so I was no stranger to being treated like that.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I ran away from home, you know. After my parents died, there was nowhere else to go. So the only thing left for me was...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Death.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Then that person sat next to me. We didn't talk the entire time. He only gently waited for me to calm down...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: But when he left, I realized a cassette tape was sitting on my knee.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: That man brought Laura into my life, at a time when there was only darkness.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: She became my sister. She protected me, encouraged me, and helped me pull myself together...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Laura was already long dead by then.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Her background, experiences, and even appearance all resembled yours. The man gave you motivation when you were at your lowest...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: As well as anger, confusion, and a deep-rooted thirst for vengeance...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: No doubt, that was no better than before.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Was that grief I saw flash through your eyes...? Or... pity? No, that's not it either...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: More like... understanding, sympathy.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Did something similar happen to you?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Do you know him?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: He's an expert at grafting non-existent joy and anger onto your life, much like how an unscrupulous director adds extra elements as he pleases to a story he deems dull...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Oh, I suppose you would call it 'ad-libbing' in the film industry.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: He pulls you from one pit of despair while guiding you into another, thus inciting the so-called beauty of drama.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...He's an old acquaintance, my teacher, the source of all my suffering, and a phantom that should be long dead.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Finding you, finding him...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Is the very reason I came here.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Moira, I'm sorry for denying all that you have.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: No. It's not like that.
Moira finishes arranging her last mannequin, and returns to the center of the prop room.
She does a curtsy in Lucian's direction, and lightly taps her fingertips.
Lucian then realizes something has changed, and looks over to see that every mannequin has come 'alive'.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I don't think you've denied me.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: In my worst hour, Laura appeared by my side, and has accompanied me for a long time now...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: She's my sister, as I am hers.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I don't regret avenging her. I don't regret shouldering all these sins.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I will also be the last person in this land to remember her.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I cry, I laugh, I rage, I doubt, I hate, I grieve, I yearn...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: And thus I have them, these intense feelings I would never have had otherwise.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I am alive.
The mannequins begin to move.
Lucian recognizes who they were modeled after... the deceased Dalton, Shelly, Michael, Marion, and also Moira herself.
Moira stretches out her hand, and holds her mannequins' hands one by one as they move past her.
No music except the trembling ground accompanies their movements, but the tiny Zalak prop master seems to have become the most passionate dancer on the land, as she embraces her myriad...
Strange, yet elegant.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I should be thanking you, Lucian. You helped me realize it.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: When there was nothing left of 'Moira' anymore...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I felt as if I became a mirror, and that I could become—

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Anyone!

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Wake up.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Satisfaction born from despair is nothing but poison.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I've never been more awake in my entire life.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Would you also like to become my dance partner?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: ...Just like them.
As Moira finishes speaking, her dance partners throw themselves at Lucian—
